# JetBrains Marketplace Store Description — Structurizr DSL

```html
<h2>Structurizr DSL — Architecture Diagrams as Code in Your IDE</h2>

<p>
  Full language support for Structurizr DSL — the industry-standard text-based language for defining
  C4 model architecture diagrams. Write, navigate, and preview your software architecture directly
  in your JetBrains IDE with all the features developers expect.
</p>

<h3>Editing and Authoring</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Syntax Highlighting</b> — Full colorization for keywords, strings, comments, identifiers, and variable substitutions</li>
  <li><b>Intelligent Code Completion</b> — Context-aware suggestions for elements, relationships, views, and properties</li>
  <li><b>10 Live Templates</b> — Quick scaffolding for workspaces, systems, containers, components, and views</li>
  <li><b>Code Folding and Formatting</b> — Collapse blocks and auto-format DSL files with configurable style</li>
</ul>

<h3>Navigation and Analysis</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Go to Definition</b> — Ctrl+Click to jump to element definitions</li>
  <li><b>Find Usages</b> — Alt+F7 to find all references to an element</li>
  <li><b>Structure View</b> — Hierarchical tree of workspace, model, views, and elements</li>
  <li><b>9 Code Inspections</b> — Detects errors like undefined references, duplicate identifiers, and invalid colors with quick fixes</li>
</ul>

<h3>Diagram Preview and Export (Pro)</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Live Diagram Preview</b> — Real-time C4 diagram rendering as you type</li>
  <li><b>Split Editor</b> — Side-by-side DSL code and diagram view</li>
  <li><b>Multi-Format Export</b> — Export as SVG, PNG, PlantUML, or Mermaid</li>
  <li><b>Copy to Clipboard</b> — Copy diagrams in any format for instant sharing</li>
  <li><b>CLI Integration</b> — Auto-download and manage the Structurizr CLI</li>
</ul>

<h3>Pricing</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Free:</b> Syntax highlighting, code completion, navigation, inspections, live templates, formatting</li>
  <li><b>Pro:</b> Live diagram preview, split editor, multi-format export, CLI integration, rename refactoring</li>
</ul>

<h3>Requirements</h3>
<ul>
  <li>JetBrains IDE 2023.2+ (IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, CLion, and all others)</li>
  <li>Windows, macOS, or Linux</li>
</ul>

<h3>Support</h3>
<ul>
  <li><a href="https://github.com/JirakJ/structurizr-dsl-plugin/issues">Issue Tracker</a></li>
  <li><a href="https://docs.structurizr.com/dsl/language">Structurizr DSL Language Reference</a></li>
  <li><a href="https://c4model.com/">C4 Model Documentation</a></li>
</ul>
```
